about: I'm Sumedh Meshram, a B.Tech student in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering at MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune. I specialize in full-stack web development with the MERN stack and am passionate about building dynamic, user-centric applications. Currently diving deep into cloud and DevOps technologies like AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, I aim to streamline software delivery through CI/CD and infrastructure automation. I enjoy working on real-world projects—from finance tracking apps to secure communication systems using blockchain and cryptography—and strive to blend my software skills with impactful innovation.
